caption: The drawing features two main elements on a beige background. In the upper central portion of the image, there is a stylized botanical or floral motif drawn in blue with some shading that gives a slightly three-dimensional effect. The motif consists of two large, wing-like leaves or petals extending outward with curling tips, accompanied by a stem and several rounded berry-like shapes on one side, all outlined and filled with blue pigment over a diffused gray background. Below this, near the center-bottom of the drawing, there is a simple line drawing in pencil of a rounded jar or crock with two small side handles. The jar is labeled with the text "N. YORK" around the neck and features the same floral motif as above, but rendered only in outline without color. The artist's signature, "G. Capelli," is found in the lower left corner of the composition.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
